title: brunovoliv's XP Bar RP
description: Changes icons.png and does some tweaks at your hot bar icons. thats all it does modinth moderators, fr.
body:
Hello, i'm brunovoliv and this is my first pack in modrinth. Hope you like my icons.png! i got my inspiration form the xp bar from this video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VPQp1oSN0Og (at 3:21, you can see that xp bar bellow.)

This pack changes the xp bar into a barebones, silver color xp bar.
Some images here:![minimum version](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/15b01aa6127fb6bb2e4f407d2ac562c38ecddea4.png)![maximum version gemini said.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/60de29512eef40ac158e348e1fb4820212f7474f.png)

I made this pack with Paint.NET and a template from fandom.com. Hope people will use my pack.
